# AP Pest Control

> Independent, family-owned pest control with 35+ years of experience serving South Florida and the Arizona Valley. Sustainable, modern programs with a satisfaction guarantee.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of AP Pest Control's two service regions and approach.
- [South Florida](/southflorida): Pest programs across Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, and West Palm Beach — mosquitoes, roaches, rodents, termites, centipedes, millipedes, no-see-ums.
- [Arizona Valley](/arizona): Pest programs across Scottsdale, Phoenix, Tucson, Marana, Oro Valley, Peoria, Buckeye, Glendale, Gilbert, and Chandler — scorpions, spiders, termites, roaches, rodents.
- [Contact](/contact): Request a free estimate in either region.
